value.title: Play Off! Ocho vs Oran
value.synopsis: Hiromi wins the tournament and is hailed throughout the school as the second most successful newcomer following Madame Butterfly. Munekata starts training Hiromi and her team hard for tomorrow's final.

value.title: Love! Love! Love! Toudou-san
value.synopsis: At the celebration party for Nishi High's group win, Kyoko Otowa hands in her club resignation. Munakata is shocked, but her decision is firm.

value.title: Burn! Special Training at Kogarashi
value.synopsis: Hiromi can't get along with Madam Butterfly, and their pairing isn't working out. Increasingly worried, Hiromi's playing only worsens. As if to reject her further, Madam Butterfly takes a day off from practice.

value.title: Birth of the Secret Double Combinations
value.synopsis: With their eyes set on the Kanto Tournament, Hiromi and Reika are training hard. However, Hiromi's misplays are rampant. But the invincible doubles pair of Todo and Ozaki are there to watch over her.

value.title: Terror of the Tornado Serve!
value.synopsis: The first round of the Kanto Junior Doubles Championship series has begun. Reika and Hiromi face a tough opponent: Showa High. Reika continues to ignore her partner and play by herself.

value.title: Growling! The Evil Twist Serve
value.synopsis: Hiromi and Reika are backed against the wall after losing the first set. But Kihara and Izuka are relentless with their Tornado Serve. Finally, the second set hits a 5-5 deuce. Will Hiromi and Reika be able to break through the Tornado Serve?

value.title: Beat the Black Spy!
value.synopsis: Just running fast won't get you far in tennis. That's Coach Munakata's advice to a proud Hiromi as she runs around. But besides training more, there's nothing else she can do for now.

value.title: The Bloodstained Comeback
value.synopsis: The doubles semifinals have begun. As Hiromi rushes to the court, a lone girl suddenly stands in her way: Her opponent, Yumi Kawamura of Ohara High.

value.title: Rally in the Morning Sun
value.synopsis: With the Kanto Junior Championship finals match in sight, Hiromi's training kicks into high gear. And on the court, shining in the morning sun, Hiromi sees Todo training in silence.

value.title: Danger! Doubles Finals
value.synopsis: Finally, the Kanto Ladies' doubles finals are here. Her heart swirls with anxiety and hope as Hiromi stands on the court. But at that very moment, as Reika is in the car, on the way to the match, an unexpected disaster unfolds.

value.title: No Need for Tears at the Graduation Match!
value.synopsis: One day, as Captain Hoshino's send-off match nears, Kyoko asks Coach Munakata if she can be paired with Hiromi. Then, she gives Hiromi a notebook filled with all of her shortcomings. Just what is Kyoko's intention?

value.title: Drive! This One Ball
value.synopsis: The South Kanto Training Camp, which takes the top junior players, is taking place with 17 players, including Hiromi. All of the strongest players that Hiromi's faced so far.

value.title: The Love Letter that Danced Around the Court
value.synopsis: Hiromi wins the practice match for the secondary member selection. But Munakata tells her that a match won without so much as an ace is no win at all and orders her to do even more training.

value.title: Don`t Lose at Men`s Tennis!
value.synopsis: With the magnificent Mt. Fuji as a backdrop, the training camp finally reaches its climax. Among them, who will be chosen as a secondary member?

value.title: Hiromi Vs Ochou! The Last Showdown
value.synopsis: The meeting about secondary members has begun. But Hiromi's name isn't there. Then, she's given a single chance: She has to win a match against Madam Butterfly.
